As a non-native speaker of English, I always pay attention to different idiomatic ways to say a person died or is dying.

Well, in general I'm not obsessed with death per se. A while ago an English speaking friend told me that his mom passed away. I didn't understand she had died, I thought she just left, so I started asking "passed away where?", and it was kind of awkward when I realized the real meaning of that expression.

Anyway, since then I learnt the following ways to express a similar idea:

  • He sleeps with the fishes (from Godfather, I believe)
  • He pushed up daisies (kind of funny)
  • He's on his last legs

Of course I know many more idioms for that, but those three I like the best for some reason.
